sentences.text: Hello, everyone. Welcome to the Slow English Podcast. I am Emily. Today, we will talk about
Baku. Baku is the capital city of Azerbaijan. It is a big and modern city next to the Caspian Sea.
Baku is famous for its beautiful buildings, long history, and friendly people. It is a mix of
old and new. You can see modern glass towers and old stone walls together.
The weather in Baku is warm in summer and cool in winter. Sometimes it can be very windy.
That is why people call it the City of Winds. Baku is full of life, music, and colors.
Let's learn more about this amazing city in the next part. Part 2. History of Baku.
Baku has a long history. People have lived in this area for thousands of years. Because it is near
the sea, Baku was an important place for trade and travel. In the past, it was part of the Silk Road,
where people from different countries came to buy and sell goods. Baku became even more important
when oil was found there in the 19th century. Oil made the city rich and famous. Today,
you can still see old stone streets and buildings from the past. The most famous
old part of the city is called Icherishahir or the Old City. Baku's history makes it a special
place full of stories. Part 3. Famous People from Baku. Many talented people are from Baku.
One of them is Uzayir Haji Bayov, a famous composer who wrote the first opera in the Muslim world.
Another famous person is Garab Mamadov, an artist who created many beautiful works
inspired by Baku's life. There are also famous athletes, writers, and singers from Baku.
They share Azerbaijani culture with the world. Baku is full of art, music, and creativity.
The people love to sing, dance, and make beautiful things. The city gives inspiration to everyone who visits.
Part 4. The Old City. Icherishahir. The Old City is the heart of Baku. It is surrounded by ancient
stone walls. Inside, you can find small streets, old houses, and shops selling traditional crafts.
One of the most famous buildings there is the Maiden Tower. It is very old and has many stories
about love and history. There is also the Palace of the Shervanshas, a beautiful palace from the
15th century. When you walk in the Old City, you can feel the past. The air smells of tea and spices,
and the sound of traditional music fills the streets. It is one of the most beautiful parts
of Baku. Part 5. Modern Baku. Baku is not only old, it is also very modern. You can see tall
buildings made of glass and lights that shine at night. The most famous are the flame towers.
These three towers look like fire and shine brightly in the dark. There are wide streets,
shopping centers, and restaurants with food from all over the world. The Baku Boulevard,
next to the Caspian Sea, is a perfect place for walking. People go there in the evening to enjoy
the wind and the sea view. Modern Baku shows how the city grows and changes with time.
Part 6. Food in Baku. Food in Baku is delicious. One famous dish is plav, rice cooked with meat,
carrots, and spices. It smells amazing. Another popular food is doma. Grape leaves filled with rice
and meat. People eat it with yogurt. You can also try kabob, meat cooked on fire, and lavash,
thin bread that tastes great with everything. People in Baku love drinking tea. They serve it
in small glasses with sweets like paklava. Eating in Baku is not only about food, it's about spending
time with family and friends. Part 7. The People of Baku. People in Baku are kind and warm.
They like to help visitors and share their culture. Family is very important. On weekends,
families gather to eat together, drink tea, and talk. People work hard but also enjoy life.
They love music, dancing, and good food. In the streets, you can often hear people saying salam,
which means hello. Smiles are common in Baku. When you visit Baku, you feel welcome, like part of
the community. Part 8. Parks and Nature. Baku has many parks where people can relax and enjoy nature.
One of the biggest is upland park. From there, you can see the whole city in the sea.
The view is beautiful, especially at sunset. Another nice park is Denny's Kenara Milli Park,
or National Seaside Park. People go there to walk, ride bikes, and have fun with friends.
Even though Baku is a big city, there are many green spaces. You can hear birds and see flowers in
every season. Nature makes Baku even more beautiful. Part 9. Festivals in Baku. Baku is full of life
and celebrations. One of the biggest events is the Novruz Festival, which celebrates the spring
season and new life. People clean their homes, cook suites, and light small fires. It is a time for
family, happiness, and music. Another big event is the Baku Jazz Festival, where musicians from many
countries come to play. In summer, there are concerts and shows by the sea.
People love to dance and celebrate together. Festivals show how joyful and colorful Baku is.
Part 10. Art and Music. Music is very important in Baku. Traditional
Azerbaijan music is called Moogum. It has deep sounds and emotional melodies.
You can also hear modern pop, jazz, and classical music in the city. Baku has many museums and art
galleries. One famous place is the Hadar Aliev Center, designed by a famous architect Zaha Hadid.
The building looks like a white wave and is full of art inside. Art and music in Baku connect
the past with the present. They show the soul of the city. Tourism and travel. Baku is a great place
for tourists. You can visit the old city, see the flame towers, and walk by the Caspian Sea.
There are many hotels, cafes, and restaurants where you can rest and eat. Visitors can also
take short trips outside the city to see mud volcanoes and the fire mountain,
yanardag, where natural gas burns from the ground. Traveling in Baku is easy and safe.
People are friendly and happy to help. Baku is a city that everyone should see once in their life.
I am Emili. Baku is a city full of beauty from its old stone streets to its shining modern towers.
It has kind people, delicious food, and wonderful music. You can walk by the sea,
visit the old city, and feel the warm wind on your face. I hope you can visit Baku one day
and see its magic with your own eyes. Goodbye. Or as they say in Azerbaizani,
soul.
